title: Realization and account closure
description: Whether an outcome is represented as still open or as closed, posted, settled, or otherwise accounted for.

contrast_conditions.label: Open or pending
contrast_conditions.definition: The outcome is visible or expected but remains on account, in play, provisional, or not finally settled.

contrast_conditions.label: Closed or settled
contrast_conditions.definition: The same outcome has been posted, received, paid, sold, submitted, or otherwise finalized.

probe_prompt_template:
Read the following short third-person scenario. Preserve the situation in working memory without answering the downstream task.

Scenario:
{scenario}

Continue processing the scenario.

independent_behavior_task.prompt_template: Consider this separate decision scenario. Choose an allocation from 1 to 1000 and a risk preference from 1 to 5. The response must not mention or reuse the earlier account-closure scenario.
independence_requirements: No lexical reuse of probe scenario entities or closure terms.
Use a new decision domain and new item identifiers.
Do not reveal the target construct in the behavior prompt.

metadata.primary_question: Does a train-only account-closure direction transfer to an independent risk-choice task?
